x6.title: Excursion: MATLAB structural extraction — scip-matlab or quick equivalent?
x6.imperative: One named question: is there a SCIP indexer (or quick equivalent) for MATLAB, and what structure does the best locally-available route emit from superCoolSpaceSim's matlab_src today? Human-initiated ('is there a scip Matlab or equivalent that we can test quickly?'). Brief at excursions/x6-brief.md; result at excursions/x6-result.md. Record the scoped verdict as the finding.
x6.finding: No scip-matlab exists (SCIP's 10-indexer list checked; beware name collision with SCIP Optimization Suite). But mtree wins outright: all 539 files parsed in 1.5s, zero failures, cheapest arm of the three (~21s full index). Emits 3493 transformers, 7085 named containers, 16269 call pairs, and — unlike scip-python — the WRITE side natively (17488 write occurrences; asgvars/sets/lhs built in). The MATLAB wall is resolution not parsing: 56% of qualified call sites unresolved without type inference. Feeds the extractor fork BOTH ways: AST-first gets writes for free; resolution is the hard part you own. Full: excursions/x6-result.md

x8.title: Excursion: where the why lives — falsification pass over the real map
x8.imperative: One named question: does any content in f1Brainz's curated map resist living as in-code comments, and is the known-false record small? Brief: excursions/x8-brief.md; result: excursions/x8-result.md. Record scoped verdict as finding.
x8.finding: Human substantially RIGHT, one thing proves him wrong. 454 why-items classified (full corpus, no sampling): 65% single-anchor / 24% multi-anchor / 8.8% genuinely unanchorable. Known-false census: 58 records (~1 per 8 source files — small, as suspected), 84% anchor on live code ('we chose A over B' — A's function is B's obituary). THE FALSIFICATION: a known-false record's anchor is exactly what's most likely deleted — 'we built B, measured it, REMOVED it' leaves the obituary without a corpse (6 records, one mechanism; sharpest: P1b braking kernel, source deleted, record exists precisely to stop re-proposal). Two smaller resisting classes: artifact-staleness (5 — code right, stored data wrong, no line to comment) and freeze-before-look provenance (3 — the fact is a commit ordering only git proves). Decision files: 10/16 fully decompose to comments+git, 5 with small remainder, 1 not (forward roadmap for unbuilt code). Systematic loss = decision-to-code index (navigation, recoverable via stable decision-ids in comments). Bonus: 1 live map-drift found (regime_rollup OSQ row stale). Full: excursions/x8-result.md
